instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Stack condition: EMA10 > EMA20 > EMA50 and EMA100 > EMA150 > EMA200 (script condition). Entry A: stack true and close crosses above EMA10. Entry B ("Dips"): stack true and close crosses below EMA5.
exit: Long trailing stop at 8% below the highest close-based stop level (ratchets up only).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Stack requires fast group above slow group only through (EMA100>EMA150>EMA200) and (10>20>50); no relation enforced between EMA50 and EMA100.
